envelope.description: Give the ISSUE-anchored chain report its next-action rules

body.title: Give the ISSUE-anchored chain report its next-action rules
body.summary: In src/workflow/chain.ts computeNextAction, for an ISSUE head: approve-define whose command names the ISSUE document when unapproved; run-define whose command reruns the issue stage when rejected; then run-lld and approve-lld for s1; then chain-complete. An ISSUE head never yields run-hld, approve-hld, review-amendment, refresh-stale, push-tracker or sync-tracker. DEF-anchored ordering is untouched.
acceptanceChecks: an unapproved ISSUE yields approve-define whose command names the ISSUE document
a rejected ISSUE yields run-define whose command reruns the issue stage, not define
an approved ISSUE with no LLD yields run-lld for s1, with an unapproved LLD approve-lld, and with an approved LLD chain-complete
an ISSUE-anchored report never contains an HLD, amendment, stale or tracker action
the DEF-anchored next-action sequence is unchanged

tests.name: chain-issue-anchored.test.ts: unapproved ISSUE yields approve-define naming the ISSUE document
chain-issue-anchored.test.ts: rejected ISSUE yields run-define that reruns the issue stage
chain-issue-anchored.test.ts: next actions follow run-lld, approve-lld, chain-complete and never name an HLD, amendment, stale or tracker step
chain-issue-anchored.test.ts: the DEF-anchored next-action sequence is unchanged
